cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(test_content C)
enable_testing()
add_executable(check_direct direct.c)
add_test(NAME direct COMMAND check_direct)
add_executable(check_disabled helper.c)
add_test(NAME disabled COMMAND check_disabled)
set_tests_properties(disabled PROPERTIES DISABLED TRUE)
if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR STREQUAL "x86_64")
  add_executable(check_guarded guarded.c)
  add_test(NAME guarded COMMAND check_guarded)
endif()
